command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
# Eight threads, pinned: both libraries are bit-reproducible only at a fixed thread count.
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=8 GB_THREADS=8
cd /tmp
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
{ uname -m; lscpu | grep -iE 'model name|^cpu\(s\)|thread\(s\) per core|core\(s\) per socket|numa node\(s\)'; } > cpu.txt; cat cpu.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u real.py > real.log 2>&1
RC=$?
echo "real.py exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s" | tee -a real.log
grep -v '^\[LightGBM\] \[Warning\] No further splits' real.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: an assertion failed or the workload died"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'GB REAL OK' real.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
